title: Transforms made by code
about: Each derived node is made by a transform from what the store holds now; what dies when a source goes, or changes, is exactly what was made from it.

steps.xml: <doc><para>The quick brown fox.</para><para>It jumps over the lazy dog!</para></doc>
<doc><para>Alice asked for her data to be removed.</para><para>Her address appeared here.</para></doc>

checks.name: each transform made what it says

text.lowercase: alice asked for her data to be removed.|her address appeared here.
text.disemvowel: Th qck brwn fx.|t jmps vr th lzy dg!
text.concatenate: The quick brown fox.|It jumps over the lazy dog!|Alice asked for her data to be removed.|Her address appeared here.
text.interleave: The quick brown fox.|Alice asked for her data to be removed.|It jumps over the lazy dog!|Her address appeared here.

checks.name: shredding a paragraph kills what was made from its document, but not from its sibling
shredding a document kills everything made from it, transitively
adding a paragraph kills what was made from the whole document
shredding a derived node kills only what was made from it
